## Result

- Skill: delivery-review
- Review status: approved
- Package members: registered primary plan at docs/plans/2026-09-09-necessary-design-consolidation.md; exact identity in subjects. No additional Delivery member or standalone test-spec substitute.
- Upstream review ID: design-review-r2, exact five-file package, with proposal-review-r2 as direction basis.
- Review ID and round: delivery-review-r1, round 1.
- Traceability result: pass; all selected Design/Test/System requirements and relevant composition, identity, compatibility and recovery outcomes map to M1/TG-01–03 and TG-FINAL-01.
- Material findings: none.
- Correction targets: none.
- Recording status: recorded.
- Open blockers: none.
- Immediate next stage: route for the user-authorized cleanup; reviewer makes no activity or work change.
- Claim limitations: approval of the exact Delivery allocation for authorized implementation only. No completed source removal, code correctness, final Verify, branch/PR readiness, publication or installation claim.

## Independence and authority

Formal-lifecycle recording. The parent necessary-design-plan authored the plan and registered it. This separately delegated reviewer authored none of the plan or approved engineering contributions, read the full primary plan and relevant approved Design sections, and changed only this review evidence. All five Design r2 subjects and the registered plan match fresh CLI inspections. Current scoped context contains no findings or blockers; stale earlier reviews are not relied on. The three context drift observations do not invalidate the individually inspected current plan and approved five-member package; historic and superseded subjects retain their original meaning.

## Combined sequencing and proof assessment

| Area | Result and rationale |
| --- | --- |
| Exact scope and upstream trace | Pass. DES-SR-13/18/21, TEST-SR-08/10/12/14 and SYS-SR-02/04/06/07/08/09 are allocated explicitly. The two removals, three complete architecture subsections and four current navigation locations match System's selected map. Scoped legacy amendments are already reviewed; unrelated specs and provisional candidates remain untouched. |
| Sequence and intermediate state | Pass. One M1 joins source retirement with current consumer navigation, avoiding a broken intermediate checkout. Design and Delivery approval precede removal; M1 requires complete semantic and consumer proof and an independent milestone review. FU-012 correction remains route-owned and is part of coherent adoption. |
| Meaning, history and acceptance | Pass. TG-01 requires before/after comparison with actual receiving rules and rationale, preservation of unselected sections, explicit current versus historical reliance, and no implicit approval retargeting. TG-02 observes live links/readers and a rejected retired-owner contrast. These are inspectable counterexamples rather than mere keyword or deletion-count checks. |
| Operational and package boundary | Pass. TG-03 requires an empty operational diff, actual package-input inspection, all surviving source-reference classifications, and an inspected metadata/consumer disposition. Source-only is a conclusion to establish, not an assumption from Markdown extensions. A changed package dependency returns for allocation and the directly protective checks. |
| Test and execution proportionality | Pass. No test or runner retirement is selected. Test's scoped complete contract, record/runtime safety and existing command compatibility survive. Model structure, prose, readability, references and semantic review protect the changed boundary without inventing runtime benchmarks or a ledger. Known legacy prose failures are audited and compared, not relabelled passing. |
| Recovery and unforeseen readers | Pass. Unique meaning or a necessary reader stops the affected deletion and returns to Design; recovery restores the exact source/navigation slice while preserving unrelated state and old evidence. This covers the material failure and compatibility boundary without unnecessary filesystem-operation tests. |
| Final closeout | Pass. M1 review cannot substitute for a fresh independent final whole-change Code Review. The plan names that checkpoint after corrections, before distinct Verify; full branch contribution is compared from ca440d8e^ and implementation from 748ff69f. RC-SR-15 reuse requires affirmative unchanged subjects/dependencies/procedure/environment and respects freshness. |

The plan consumes the living Designs' representative boundary scenarios; it does not introduce a new boundary-first-v1 proof-map catalogue. Historical operational proof identifiers remain with their unselected responsibilities. Detailed normal/runtime negative scenarios would overstate this source-only slice; necessary failure contrasts and affected reader checks are concretely allocated instead. The candidate-owner inventory and bounded audit do not approve extra model construction or whole-spec deletions.

## Validation and limits

Ran the plan's five-member `python scripts/validate-boundary-first.py --path ...` command: passed, structure and references only. Ran `git diff --check`: passed. Fresh CLI subject inspection confirmed the plan and Design package identities. An exploratory attempt to pass the plan path itself to validate-boundary-first.py rejected that unsupported input with BFR-INVALID-CHANGED-PATH; this was reviewer misuse, not a planned command failure or a waived check. The plan correctly selects only supported model/spec paths for that validator.

No runtime, package, release or implementation proof was executed by this Delivery review. M1 must still produce its actual before/after semantic, reference and operational-unaffected evidence; this approval does not claim those outcomes already occurred. No mandatory correction or unresolved necessary decision prevents the exact package's approval under the adopted combined-condition rule.
independence_basis: Separately delegated reviewer authored none of the plan or approved engineering contributions, independently assessed exact allocation and current upstream basis, and changed only own review evidence.
